Upstream decode-uri-component 0.5.0 from https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component, MIT licensed. The decoding implementation is unchanged. Only the ESM export is adapted to CommonJS and the old 0.2 plus-sign behavior retained for query-string 7. This carries the upstream fix for GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr without upgrading React Navigation across major versions. Remove the local override when Navigation ships a compatible patched dependency. Tests exercise normal decoding and malformed input.
